item.title: Should you let AI into your inbox?
item.description: Connecting AI to Gmail, Xero or your job system sounds risky. Here's how connectors work, what you gain and how to start safely, one permission at a time.

item.title: AI isn't coming for your job. It's coming to tell you how to do it.
item.description: Tradies are less likely to be replaced by AI, but their jobs will still change. The real question is whether you end up above the algorithm, or below it.
